newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NML backs family and private business study.
newsitem.headline: NML backs family and private business study.

text.p: Life office National Mutual Life Association (NML) said on Tuesday it plans to help set up a research foundation at Melbourne's Monash University to study family and private business issues.
NML managing director Tony Killen said the life office would contribute "some hundreds of thousands of dollars" a year for the next three years to the project.

A recent Monash survey had identified a lack of planning by family and private businesses as a key issue for the sector, which has a total estimated wealth of A$1,200 billion, Killen told an Australian Institute of Company Directors lunch.
Other problems found by the survey of 1,500 businesses were succession difficulties and the lack of processes for handling conflict.
More than 60 percent of respondents also said they wanted training in family and private business, Killen said.
NML is the largest subsidiary of listed insurer National Mutual Holdings Ltd.
